items.title: How much does each spaced review add to retention?
items.description: Illustrative model, not a real memory formula: using the same simplified numbers as L3 (no review leaves about 10% retention by test day, each well-timed active-recall review adds roughly 16 points, capped at 95%), drag the number of spaced reviews to see the pattern. At 0 reviews, this reproduces Maya's scenario; at 5, it reproduces Diego's.
